headline: Kriti Industries appoints new Company Secretary
hook: New compliance leadership at Kriti Industries
summary: Kriti Industries (India) Limited held a board meeting on November 5, 2026. The company officially appointed a new Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. This is a routine corporate governance update for the firm.
why_it_matters: Routine administrative change with no immediate impact on stock performance.

headline: Kriti Industries releases Q2 financial results
hook: Kriti Industries reports September quarter financials
summary: Kriti Industries (India) Limited has officially filed its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The submission was made to the National Stock Exchange as part of the company's mandatory regulatory compliance. Retail investors can access the detailed balance sheet and profit-loss statement on the exchange website to evaluate the company's recent operational performance.
why_it_matters: Review the latest earnings to assess company profitability and growth trends.
